title: DuckMoo Nexus | Warband Financials
description: Physical Warbank gold from timestamped transfer ledger balances. Income/expenses exclude bank transfers, deposits held as principal, unresolved mail/trades and unpriced materials. Net flow is not crafting profit.

list.name: account
list.label: Account
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT namespace FROM nexus.imports UNION SELECT DISTINCT namespace FROM nexus.source_snapshots

list.name: patron_character
list.label: Patron character
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT character_key FROM nexus.crafting_order_financials WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND order_kind='Patron' ORDER BY 1

list.name: patron_profession
list.label: Patron profession
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT profession FROM nexus.crafting_order_financials WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND order_kind='Patron' AND character_key IN (${patron_character:sqlstring}) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Warbank gold: latest recorded balance
panels.description: Actual bank balance, never combined wallets. Recorded ledger state as of selected end time. See source timestamp below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT copper/10000.0 AS gold FROM nexus.warbank_history WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND observed_at<=to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0) ORDER BY observed_at DESC,source_saved_at DESC,source_ordinal ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT observed_at,source,copper/10000.0 AS gold FROM nexus.warbank_history WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND observed_at<=to_timestamp(${__to}/1000.0) ORDER BY observed_at DESC,source_saved_at DESC,source_ordinal ASC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Warbank balance over time
panels.description: Recorded balances after deposits/withdrawals. Missing intervals stay missing. Same-second records may have uncertain order.

targets.rawSql: SELECT observed_at AS time,copper/10000.0 AS "Warbank gold" FROM nexus.warbank_history WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) ORDER BY observed_at

panels.title: Patron-order gold received
panels.description: Selected period. Recorded patron commissions minus order cuts; supplied materials are not deducted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(net_copper)/10000.0 AS gold FROM nexus.crafting_order_financials WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND order_kind='Patron' AND character_key IN (${patron_character:sqlstring}) AND profession IN (${patron_profession:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

panels.title: Patron orders completed
panels.description: Completed NPC patron orders, excluding public, guild and personal orders.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM nexus.crafting_order_financials WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND order_kind='Patron' AND character_key IN (${patron_character:sqlstring}) AND profession IN (${patron_profession:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

panels.title: Patron-order gold over time
panels.description: Cumulative across all captured history for the selected characters/professions. Opening balance includes earlier orders. Raw gold after cuts, before supplied-material costs.

targets.rawSql:
WITH amounts AS (
 SELECT occurred_at,net_copper FROM nexus.crafting_order_financials WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND order_kind='Patron' AND character_key IN (${patron_character:sqlstring}) AND profession IN (${patron_profession:sqlstring}) AND gold_complete
 AND occurred_at <= $__timeTo()
), points AS (
 SELECT $__timeFrom() AS time,coalesce(sum(net_copper),0) AS copper
 FROM amounts WHERE occurred_at < $__timeFrom()
 UNION ALL SELECT occurred_at,sum(net_copper) FROM amounts
 WHERE occurred_at >= $__timeFrom() GROUP BY occurred_at
 UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo(),0
), totals AS (
 SELECT time,sum(sum(copper)) OVER (ORDER BY time)/10000.0 AS gold FROM points GROUP BY time
)
SELECT time,gold AS "Patron-order gold" FROM totals ORDER BY time

panels.title: Daily patron-order gold
panels.description: Recorded gold after order cuts, before supplied-material costs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day',occurred_at,'America/Chicago') AS time,sum(net_copper)/10000.0 AS gold FROM nexus.crafting_order_financials WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND order_kind='Patron' AND character_key IN (${patron_character:sqlstring}) AND profession IN (${patron_profession:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Net recorded gold after deposits
panels.description: Selected period: recorded income minus spending and fees, minus posting deposits plus returned deposits. Internal transfers and unresolved mail/trades are excluded. This is cash flow, not profit on sold inventory.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(net_copper)/10000.0 AS gold FROM nexus.recorded_cash_events WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

panels.title: Net auction-deposit outflow
panels.description: Posting deposits minus refunds received during the selected period. Includes lost deposits, still-held deposits and unmatched history. A negative value means more deposits were returned than posted in this period.

targets.rawSql: SELECT -sum(deposit_movement_copper)/10000.0 AS gold FROM nexus.recorded_cash_events WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

panels.title: Net recorded gold over time
panels.description: Starts at zero at the beginning of the selected period. Includes recorded listing deposits and refunds, alongside income and spending. Inventory purchases count when recorded; this is not a sale-by-sale profit calculation.

targets.rawSql:
WITH events AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT occurred_at,net_copper FROM nexus.recorded_cash_events WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND net_copper IS NOT NULL
), points AS (
 SELECT $__timeFrom() AS time,0::numeric AS copper
 UNION ALL SELECT occurred_at,sum(net_copper) FROM events GROUP BY occurred_at
 UNION ALL SELECT $__timeTo(),0
)
SELECT time,sum(sum(copper)) OVER (ORDER BY time)/10000.0 AS "Net recorded gold"
FROM points GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Auction deposits and outcomes by character
panels.description: Failure records do not contain deposit amounts or auction IDs, so failed auctions cannot be assigned an exact gold loss. Posting records are captured from posting requests; refunds are recorded when sale mail is collected.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT character,realm,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE event_kind='posting') AS posted,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE event_kind='refund') AS sale_refunds,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE event_kind='expired') AS expired,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE event_kind='cancelled') AS cancelled,
 coalesce(sum(deposit_copper) FILTER(WHERE event_kind='posting'),0)/10000.0 AS posted_g,
 coalesce(sum(deposit_copper) FILTER(WHERE event_kind='refund'),0)/10000.0 AS refunded_g,
 (coalesce(sum(deposit_copper) FILTER(WHERE event_kind='posting'),0)
  -coalesce(sum(deposit_copper) FILTER(WHERE event_kind='refund'),0))/10000.0 AS outflow_g,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE event_kind IN ('posting','refund') AND deposit_copper IS NULL) AS missing_amounts
 FROM nexus.auction_deposit_events WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY character,realm ORDER BY outflow_g DESC

panels.title: Transfers and external payments
panels.description: Money to a character proven to belong to you is a transfer. External payments affect recorded cash flow. Unmatched names remain unresolved until there is evidence.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT occurred_at AS "Recorded",character AS "Sender",realm AS "Realm",counterparty AS "Counterparty",
 cash_copper/10000.0 AS "Gold movement",CASE ownership WHEN 'external' THEN 'External payment'
 WHEN 'own_account' THEN 'Same account' WHEN 'own_other_account' THEN 'Another owned account'
 ELSE 'Unresolved' END AS "Classification",ownership_evidence AS "Evidence"
 FROM nexus.cash_transfer_classification WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC

panels.title: Patron gold by character and profession
panels.description: Profession comes from a matching captured recipe. Unknown professions remain included.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT character,realm,profession,count(*) AS orders,
 sum(gross_copper)/10000.0 AS commission_g,sum(cut_copper)/10000.0 AS cuts_g,
 sum(net_copper)/10000.0 AS received_g,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT gold_complete) AS incomplete_gold_records
 FROM nexus.crafting_order_financials WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND order_kind='Patron' AND character_key IN (${patron_character:sqlstring}) AND profession IN (${patron_profession:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY received_g DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Patron-order history
panels.description: Latest 250 orders in the selected period. Completion time is recorded by Journalator; it is not a mailbox-collection timestamp.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT occurred_at AS completed_at,character,realm,profession,item_name,
 gross_copper/10000.0 AS commission_g,cut_copper/10000.0 AS cut_g,
 net_copper/10000.0 AS received_g,supplied_materials FROM nexus.crafting_order_financials WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND order_kind='Patron' AND character_key IN (${patron_character:sqlstring}) AND profession IN (${patron_profession:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
 ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id LIMIT 250

panels.title: Patron data coverage
panels.description: Missing payment fields are excluded from gold totals. Item/currency rewards are not assigned a gold value.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS orders,count(*) FILTER(WHERE profession='Unknown profession') AS unknown_profession,
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT gold_complete) AS incomplete_gold_records,
 min(occurred_at) AS first_order,max(occurred_at) AS latest_order FROM nexus.crafting_order_financials WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND order_kind='Patron' AND character_key IN (${patron_character:sqlstring}) AND profession IN (${patron_profession:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
SELECT sum(income_copper)/10000.0 AS gold FROM nexus.cash_financial_components WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)

panels.title: Recorded expenses
panels.description: Does not include unmatched lost auction deposits or unpriced crafting materials.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(expense_copper)/10000.0 AS gold FROM nexus.cash_financial_components WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
SELECT sum(income_copper-expense_copper)/10000.0 AS gold FROM nexus.cash_financial_components WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
SELECT sum(expense_copper)/10000.0 AS gold FROM nexus.cash_financial_components WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND component='auction sale'

SELECT date_trunc('day',occurred_at,'America/Chicago') AS time,sum(income_copper)/10000.0 AS income,-sum(expense_copper)/10000.0 AS expenses FROM nexus.cash_financial_components WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT component,sum(income_copper)/10000.0 AS income_g,sum(expense_copper)/10000.0 AS expense_g,sum(income_copper-expense_copper)/10000.0 AS net_g FROM nexus.cash_financial_components WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY net_g DESC

SELECT character,realm,sum(income_copper)/10000.0 AS income_g,sum(expense_copper)/10000.0 AS expense_g FROM nexus.cash_financial_components WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY income_g DESC

panels.title: Crafting orders, including patron orders
panels.description: Order type retained as source enum. Commission net excludes own reagent costs, so it is not profit.

targets.rawSql: SELECT character,realm,order_type,count(*) AS orders,sum(income_copper)/10000.0 AS tips_g,sum(expense_copper)/10000.0 AS cuts_g,count(*) FILTER(WHERE has_crafter_materials) AS orders_with_own_materials FROM nexus.cash_financial_components WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND category='Fulfilling' GROUP BY 1,2,3

panels.title: Auction deposit principal and unresolved money
panels.description: Principal returned is not new income. Failed/cancelled deposits are not matched to invoices yet.

targets.rawSql: SELECT component,sum(internal_transfer_copper)/10000.0 AS deposit_cash_g,sum(uncertain_copper)/10000.0 AS unresolved_g FROM nexus.cash_financial_components WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(internal_transfer_copper)<>0 OR sum(uncertain_copper)<>0

panels.title: Category coverage and incomplete attribution
panels.description: Coverage spans all imported history. Unclassified records are never silently converted into income.

targets.rawSql: SELECT * FROM nexus.financial_coverage WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} ORDER BY records DESC

panels.title: Cached character balances, separately
panels.description: Latest preserved file for each source and character. File save time is shown separately from source observation time. Cached balances are not added to Warbank gold.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON(o.source,o.entity) o.source,o.entity,o.copper/10000.0 AS gold,o.observed_at,o.time_precision,o.quality,s.source_saved_at AS snapshot_file_saved_at FROM nexus.source_observations o JOIN nexus.snapshot_observations l ON l.observation_id=o.id JOIN nexus.source_snapshots s ON s.id=l.snapshot_id WHERE o.namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND o.kind='character_balance' ORDER BY o.source,o.entity,s.source_saved_at DESC NULLS LAST,s.captured_at DESC,s.id DESC

panels.title: Other bank observations and source quality
panels.description: Includes timestamp-free Syndicator cache and legacy samples; excluded from primary balance history.

targets.rawSql: SELECT source,observed_at,copper/10000.0 AS gold,quality FROM nexus.source_observations WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} AND kind='warbank_balance' AND quality<>'recorded_after_transfer' ORDER BY observed_at DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT source,count(*) AS snapshots,max(source_saved_at) AS latest_file_save,max(imported_at) AS latest_archive,max(normalized_version) AS normalized_version FROM nexus.source_snapshots WHERE namespace=${account:sqlstring} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
